add_densepose_config: add all DensePose configuration options to a Detectron2 CfgNode including head, HRNet, bootstrap, dataset, and evaluation settings
add_densepose_head_config: add DensePose head configuration options like NUM_PATCHES, HEATMAP_SIZE, POOLER_TYPE, and predictor/loss names to a CfgNode
add_densepose_head_cse_config: add Continuous Surface Embeddings configuration options like EMBED_SIZE, loss weights, and cycle consistency parameters to a CfgNode
add_hrnet_config: add HRNet backbone configuration options for stages 2-4 including NUM_BRANCHES, NUM_CHANNELS, and FUSE_METHOD to a CfgNode
load_bootstrap_config: load and convert bootstrap dataset entries from plain dicts into CfgNode format and merge with default configuration
